mentions.name: Markdown Ninja
mentions.description: A Markdown-first CMS and website builder for blogs, newsletters and documentation websites. It provides a complete publishing platform intended to replace complex, fragile setups that combine CI/CD pipelines, static site builders, hosting, CDNs and analytics. The platform is fully operational, is being open sourced, and supports publishing directly from the CLI via the mdninja publish command.
mentions.problem: Running a blog or startup website traditionally requires juggling a CI/CD pipeline, static site builder, hosting, CDN and analytics — a complex and fragile setup that this platform replaces with a single Markdown-first publishing solution.
mentions.audience: Bloggers and startups currently relying on complex, fragile website setups (CI/CD pipelines, static site builders, hosting, CDN, analytics).
